text:
emma: Heads-up: HelioCare's renewal invoice (INV-7219) shows both renewed private license and a full-support tier charge after they asked to downgrade to standard support mid-renewal. Link: https://invoices.internal/INV-7219. Can billing confirm? cc @tara

jon: I see on the contract they signed renewal on 2026-05-05 for a private-license annual term starting 06/01. Support downgrade request was sent 2026-05-20 (effective 06/01). The invoice was generated 05/06 and includes annual support at premium tier. Seems timing mismatch between renewal cut and support change.

tara: Sales notes show explicit customer request to downgrade to Standard at renewal. We should pro-rate the support line for the year and credit the premium portion from 06/01 forward. Customer escalation on 2026-06-02.

matt: Invoice extract: 
```
private_license   36,000.00   06/01/2026 - 05/31/2027
support_premium   9,000.00    annual (06/01/2026)
```
Support standard annual would be 4,500.00. Difference = 4,500.00 credit for full year. But because downgrade requested before term start, do we credit whole year or pro-rate back to effective date? Legal? @pam

pam: If customer requested downgrade prior to term start and we acknowledged before term start, we should apply full-year credit for the premium vs standard delta. Need written confirmation attached. Check that sales acknowledged request before 06/01.

jon: Sales acknowledged via SFDC note on 05/25 and account exec emailed customer confirming downgrade on 05/26. Attachment exists.

emma: OK so action: issue credit memo for $4,500 against INV-7219, GL 4-110-SupportCredits, attach SFDC note + email. No cash refund. Approve? @matt for posting.

matt: approve. Creating ADJ. Calculator: 9000 - 4500 = 4500. ADJ will be -4500.00.

billing-bot: Adjustment created: ADJ-10122 amount: -4500.00 status: pending approval.

pam: Legal: make sure memo text includes "support tier downgrade confirmed 05/26/2026". Also include link to SFDC.

matt: ADJ-10122 issued and applied to INV-7219. Amount: $4,500.00 credit. GL posted to 4-110-SupportCredits. Memo: https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-10122. Attached SFDC note and confirmation email.

emma: Noted. I'll update the renewal billing dashboard and mark this as closed. Customer notified. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
